verdict.rationale: Belvo markets its own recurring payment products: Direct Debit ("accept recurring bank payments") and Smart Transfers ("automate recurring payments with Pix"). Smart Collections docs describe automated, balance-conditioned Pix collections that Belvo monitors in the background and signals via notification. Most of this evidence is homepage taglines, so the developer-facing depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API flow for creating and managing standing/recurring consents, technical details of the Direct Debit and Smart Transfers mandate lifecycle, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
